name: Radiant
summary: Radiant develops portable microreactors for resilient power. It announced more than $300 million of Series D financing in December 2025, without disclosing a valuation.
overview: Radiant is developing portable nuclear microreactors intended for remote and mission-critical power. Its private-market case depends on moving from reactor development to repeatable production and deployment.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Radiant announced more than $300 million in new funding to scale production; its valuation was not disclosed.

bull_case: Portable nuclear power could address high-value demand where grid access is constrained or resilience is critical.
bear_case: Licensing, fuel, manufacturing and deployment create long, capital-intensive execution paths; valuation is undisclosed.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

company: Radiant develops portable microreactors intended to provide resilient clean power where conventional infrastructure is constrained. The company is pursuing a manufacturing-led path to nuclear deployment.

intelligence.why_it_matters: Radiant is a private bet on compact nuclear power for resilience-sensitive customers. Licensing and first commercial deployments are the decisive milestones.
